Featured Article

High elves and blood elves are physiologically the same race, and they are descended from night elves. Nevertheless, the three groups do not share a close relationship due to their shared history and philosophical differences. Indeed, night elves regard high elves and blood elves with suspicion, disgust, or outright hostility.

Nevertheless, high elves and blood elves do share some characteristics with their night elf brethren. All three groups have unusually acute senses and are able to see clearly even in low-light conditions. (more...)

2008 ARCHIVE · HISTORICAL EXHIBIT
2008 card-rewards identity page

This independent archive displays the retired identity page as a historical exhibit. The former rewards service is unavailable.

The captured 2008 interface was used for a card-rewards identity check. The service has been retired and this exhibit contains no editable fields, sign-in action, or current account workflow.

What the historical interface showed
Fields visible in the capture
The page contained a full name, postal code, date of birth, last four digits of a Social Security Number, and a security-code field.
Historical purpose
Those labels belonged to the former rewards service’s identity-check flow in the 2008 capture.

No personal, account, or payment information is requested here. Please treat the labels above as archival description only.
